positions.name: UnitedHealth Group Inc.
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 blowout + FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE RAISE. Adjusted EPS $6.38 vs $4.85 consensus (+31% beat); revenue $112.0B vs $110.76B est. Raised FY26 adj EPS guide to $19.50-$20.00 (midpoint $19.75) vs $18.48 Street. Stock +~6.7% pre-market to a fresh 52-week high (prior 52wk high $434.30 on 7/9).
positions.driver: Fresh, unambiguous idiosyncratic earnings catalyst with a guidance raise well above consensus in a large-cap, lower-beta defensive name. Healthcare-comeback narrative with room to run — up only ~6.7% pre-market, below the >8-10% chase threshold — and a clean, definable stop just above the pre-earnings close (~$418.5).
positions.risks: Managed-care sentiment can be headline-driven (MLR/utilization, regulatory/policy risk). Buying an extended breakout to new highs risks a gap-fill fade if the pop reverses. Broad risk-off (chip rout spillover — SK Hynix -6%, Kospi -7%) could pressure the tape. Hard stop at -6% ($419.90) caps downside back to roughly the pre-print close.
